extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF, figure captions, and supplement methods; claims avoid promoting discussion-only hypotheses to direct mechanism.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Darobactin B compared with darobactin A
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Darobactin B is supported as binding the same BamA beta-barrel site as darobactin A.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The claim is limited to DAR B/BamA binding evidence in this paper and does not generalize direct binding to all analogs.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Darobactin A plus Darobactin B checkerboard assays
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Checkerboard assays are consistent with non-synergistic/additive behavior for DAR A and DAR B against E. coli MG1655 and K. pneumoniae ATCC 700603, supporting shared-site interpretation without proving a separate mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: FICI evidence is interpreted only as context for shared binding-site behavior; it is not treated as direct structural proof.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: DAR C, DAR D, DAR E, DAR F activity differences
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Author discussion links reduced activity of DAR D/E/F to sequence changes and BamA/lipid interaction hypotheses; these are preserved as mechanistic hypotheses, not direct mechanism findings.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct binding assay is reported for DAR C/D/E/F in the final ontology record.
